notes.title: Map Merge Update (0.2.7)
notes.notes:
***[0.2.7] • 2020-09-18***

*ADDED*
• Two new bot levels - Super Easy and Super Hard. Let's see if someone can 1v4 four super hard bots :feuer:
• Functionallity to mute single players

*CHANGED*
• The bots now matching their level on their kda. If they play bad during a match, they'll increase their level, else they decrease. The starting level is medium.
• All GoalTower maps (Sneaky, Dome, Millerntor) are now available for the modes Elimination and 
Deathmatch
• The Deathmatch map Shield is now available for the mode Elimination
• The Elimination maps Maze, Rig and Elbtunnel are now available for the mode Deathmatch
• You are able to change your voted game mode now
• bHaptics vest countdown vibrations and the low health vibration removed
• The preconfigured settings in the create match panel changed to mode user vote
• Health loss while inside the tower increased from 10 dmg/s to 15 dmg/s

*FIXED*
• 24-Hours match duration achievement achievable now
• Total match time is now displayed correctly if you have more than 24 hours
• When joining a room during commendation scene you won't get the receiving stats pop up anymore. This was not intended, just like in training matches.
• Some further fixes in stability

PS: We did not add maps to GoalTower, because this mode needs extra work to get a good map. We hope to add some new soon
die release notes

notes.title: The Competition Update (0.2.6)
notes.notes:
With our new update we come a big step closer to our vision of virtual e-sports. In addition to the new features, which we will discuss in more detail below, we will be hosting a major tournament at Gamescom. The Gamescom Cup. We invite all Tower Tag players to take part to win cash and nice prizes.

There will be one tournament each for the Europe region and for the North America region.

More information and registration now here:
-> Europe Region
-> North America region 
(!) Please note that the number of places for participation is limited.

Highlights in 0.2.6:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37848469/149977a0047f5b1de339ab2b94507297ac8c3517.jpg
Global leaderboard
Based on the ELO algorithm, we have brought a global leaderboard into play. This allows individual players to compare themselves with each other. Since we are still in early access, it is possible that we will change the way we calculate in the near future. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37848469/94632f9f69d47104cde59b5f36470a8af00f5494.jpg
Score progress visualization
From now on you will get a display after every match which shows you your progress in terms of global score and EP level.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37848469/b019e83906a16ebc1326f6b68490eb85286c7ca1.jpg
Play with more bots (co-op)
If you want to play together with your friends against bots this is now possible. You and your friends have to join a team together. The other team must remain free. If you then choose "Vote For Start Now", the bots will be added automatically.

General patch notes:
ADDED
• Leaderboard for steam users in main menu (viveport WIP)
• Announcer for the tutorial
• Match time duration from 3 up to 10 minutes for custom matches
• Autostart toggle for custom matches
• Info texts when hovering the labels in the custom match UI
• A holo pop up in commendation scene which displays your progress (EP, SCORE, LVL) to you
• Idle detection. A inactive player will be kicked after 2 minutes. 
• Reward speaker sounds (Doublekill, Headshot, Snipershot, Payback)

CHANGED
• Oculus Controller now shoot with a trigger treshold value instead of click
• Weapon penalty for holding the gun in tower reacts and releases earlier (blocking shots for 0.25 sec)
• Team changes are possible without a request. You just need to send requests, if the enemy team is full
• Match Time selection in the custom match UI becomse a slider
• Rooms created through Quick Join will start after 2 minutes (was 1.30 before)
• Rooms created with the Custom Match UI will also have a 2 minutes start timer if autostart is enabled
• Renamed "Rank" to "Level" to avoid miss understandings with the rank in the highscore list
• The min count of players per match is now 4. So if you are alone and press "Start Now", then 3 bots will join instead of just 1. If you are 2 players, there will spawn 2 bots instead of 0.
--> if you want to play 1 vs 1 just open a custom room and set max players to 2

FIXED
• After joining a full room and getting kicked again you won't stuck in main menu without pointer anymore
PS: The leaderboard will add you to the ranking table when you login for the first time - so there are just few entries atm, because it just contains players who already logged into the latest version.
PSS: Free TeamChange means : You can get in a room with 4 players, all in the same team and you will play against 4 bots.

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone. We got a sweet little update for you guys! Currently, we are working on some bigger fixes, features and the tournament (check #summer-cup) right now, so this patch is not that big, but still necessary.

[0.2.3] • 2020-06-12


ADDED

• Get your mates together and build up teams! Did you guys already know about our tournament? We added an info panel with a hyperlinked image in the main menu. Just click on it to open our tournament info page in your browser.
• Where am I? To ensure you guys know on which region you currently play, we added a dropdown on the top-left corner of the Custom Match UI (room list) where you additionally can change your current region.  See Changed section for more news about that.

CHANGED

• Did you every travel between North America, Asia, and Europe in a few seconds? No? We got you! The region change does not need an application restart anymore!
• We allow the quick reset of the playspace in the hubscene now. This is to reduce the complications with the playspace issue of Rift S and Quest users. 
• We removed the china region because it causes region change issues. Global and Europe regions merged. 

FIXED

• We removed a visual bug while scene loading, where the teleportstripes were visible in front of you.
• AAAAAND a (hopefully) huge performance improvement while changing scenes and at the start of the application. We guess that this also removes the low-resolution problem where the application suddenly downscales the resolution dramatically.

We don't want to split our game into small groups, so we focused on some important regions. Please be sure to update your region.

notes.title: small patch
notes.notes:
***[0.2.1] • 2020-05-29***

**ADDED**

• Quick tip to the friends panel (steam only)
• Hyperlink to our discord channel in the main menu

**CHANGED**

• When you use the Quick Playspace Reset (Hold Trigger + Menu* Button for 3 sec) it will also apply the look direction of your headset!

**FIXED**

• Game mode votes should be reset after a match again, so you can switch the modes after every game (if not hard selected by custom match creation)
• Vote for start now synchronization
• Rotation value in playspace tab not infinite anymore
*Rift: A or X | Vive: Menu | Knuckles: A | WMR: Menu
